628-7214-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

1170-5060-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5060-5131-6798--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-5060-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

1768-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

855-2021-2060-3334.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

489-2781-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-1379-2685-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1379-2685-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2946-4871-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2292-2946-4871-7316.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

81-4644-7791.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

4506-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4506-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
4506-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

1368-1563-4460-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-4460-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

64-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7235.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three total creatures on the battlefield.
2034-6972-7235.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

893-997-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

480-2511-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1328-2105-7060.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-7060.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-4518-6930-7055.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

4740-5078-5313-6918.manaNeeded: {2} minus {1} for each 3 life you have and minus {1} if your storm count is 2 or greater
4740-5078-5313-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

122-328-2732-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Repeat.

222-527-2921-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2921-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

338-2557-3490-3910-5296.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
338-2557-3490-3910-5296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2557-3490-3910-5296.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

505-1379-1558-1908.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
505-1379-1558-1908.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Izoni with haste.
Put the token Izoni into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Izoni token enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

513-1304-4618.notablePrerequisites: Nature's Chosen attached to any creature you control without summoning sickness that can tap to produce at least {G}.
513-1304-4618.description:
Activate the creature with Nature's Chosen attached by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Nature's Chosen's first ability by paying {0}, untapping the creature.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting the creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Nature's Chosen to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Instill Energy, attaching it to the creature.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping the creature.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, targeting the creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nature's Chosen, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.

717-1742-1957-2366-3878.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Dryad Arbor, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's first and second ability triggers, along with Faith of the Devoted.
Resolve the first Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the second Bone Miser trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Faith of the Devoted trigger, causing you to pay {1} to cause each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1734-2034-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-3558-3593-4939.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Burning-Tree Emissary onto the battlefield.
Burning-Tree Emissary and Cloudstone Curio each trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand.
Repeat.

2493-4377-4428.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

64-1193-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
64-1193-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Warden of the Eye.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna besides the original, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
The token copy of Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.
